job.question: Which retirement plan's investment consulting RFP requires that, as of December 31, 2024, the firm have at least three public fund clients each with at least $1B in assets and have been in business at least ten years?
job.expected_facts: The Retirement Plan for CTA Employees (Chicago Transit Authority), in its April 29, 2025 investment consulting RFP.
job.acceptance: Retirement Plan for CTA/Chicago Transit Authority Employees; publication date is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2023 Oklahoma OPERS investment management RFP, not the CTA Employees investment consulting RFP. Its ten-year criterion applies to senior investment professionals, not the firm's time in business; it does not require three public fund clients each with at least $1 billion in assets as of December 31, 2024.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-24-001 U.S. EQUITY, Non-U.S. EQUITY, AND FIXED INCOME (TIPS) INDEX INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES
OPERS RFP – Investment Management Services – Issued July 20, 2023 Page 1 of 17
The senior investment professionals in charge of the proposed mandates must have at least ten years of institutional experience within fixed income and/or equity indexing space.
Provide three references for the largest public fund clients who employ your firm.
